publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.textBefore: Bobine is a personal project, with no commercial structure, developed and operated from France. There isn't a dedicated public contact address yet: in the meantime, you can reach us

service.title: The service
service.textBefore: Bobine lets you discover movies and shows, keep track of a personal library ("watched", "want to watch", custom lists), and receive notifications about new releases. Catalog data, pages, posters, and streaming availability come from third-party services (see our
service.textAfter: ) and are provided for informational purposes only: we do not guarantee their accuracy or completeness.

account.title: Account and sign-in
account.text: Creating an account is done via email, using a single-use sign-in link (no password is stored). You are responsible for the security of access to your email inbox, the only way to access your account.

usage.title: Permitted use
usage.text: The service is provided free of charge, for personal, non-commercial use. Any automated or abusive use (mass data scraping, bypassing security measures or rate limits) is prohibited.

availability.title: Availability and evolution of the service
availability.text1: Bobine is a personal project under active development: features, appearance, and availability may change, including being interrupted, without notice. No guarantee of continuous availability is provided (no service level commitment).
availability.text2: The service is free today and will remain so for its current features; an optional funding method (one-off donations) may be introduced in the future, without making access to the service paid.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: The service is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. To the extent permitted by French law, the publisher cannot be held liable for damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service.

law.title: Governing law
law.text: These terms are governed by French law.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.text: These terms may be updated as the service evolves. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page; we encourage you to check it regularly.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.textBefore: Bobine is a personal project, with no commercial structure, operated from France. The data processing described below is therefore governed by French law and the GDPR. There isn't a dedicated public contact address yet: in the meantime, you can reach us

account.label: Account
account.text: : your email address (the only information requested at sign-up), used for single-use link/code sign-in — no password is stored. You can also set an optional display name, visible on your account card and synced across your devices.

library.label: Personal library
library.text: : the movies/shows you mark as "watched" or "want to watch", your custom lists, and their content.

preferences.label: Preferences
preferences.text: : excluded genres, favorite streaming platforms, region.

push.label: Push notifications
push.text: (if you enable them): your browser's technical subscription identifier and the associated encryption keys, used solely to send you the new-release notifications you requested. If you are signed in to your account on this device, this subscription is linked to your account so these notifications can be delivered directly in the app on your signed-in devices; it is unlinked as soon as you sign out on this device.

technical.label: Technical data
technical.text: : your IP address is processed briefly to limit abuse (anti-spam on sign-in), without being kept in a form identifiable to your account.

why.title: Why we use it
why.text: This data is used solely to operate the account, library, and notifications you explicitly requested. The legal basis is the performance of the service you ask us for (account, watchlist) and, for push notifications, your explicit consent (manually enabled in the app, revocable at any time).

sharing.title: Who this data is shared with
sharing.intro: Bobine relies on the following providers to operate:

tmdb.label: TMDB
tmdb.text: (The Movie Database): provides the catalog, pages, and posters — no personal data is sent to it, only content requests.

resend.label: Resend
resend.text: : sends the emails containing your sign-in link/code — receives your email address for this purpose only.

recaptcha.label: Google reCAPTCHA
recaptcha.text: : protects certain forms against bots, under Google's privacy policy.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare
cloudflare.text: : hosts the application and the database (Workers, D1).

sentry.label: Sentry
sentry.text: : receives technical errors occurring in the application (browser and server), for the sole purpose of diagnosing and fixing them. An error may occasionally contain technical details (URL visited, error message) but no account data is intentionally sent to it.

analytics.label: Cloudflare Web Analytics
analytics.text: : anonymous audience measurement (page views, visitors) — no cookies, no persistent identifier, no personal data.

gravatar.label: Gravatar
gravatar.text: (Automattic): displays your profile picture if you've set one up linked to your email address. We never send your email address in clear text to Gravatar, only its fingerprint (MD5 hash), in line with how this service works.

sharing.outro: None of this data is sold or used for advertising purposes.

cookies.title: Cookies and measurement tools
cookies.text: Bobine uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to measure site traffic anonymously, without cookies or identifiers that would allow tracking a person from one visit to another. Sentry is used to track and diagnose technical errors (see above). Neither of these two tools is used for advertising or profiling purposes. Should a new audience-measurement or ad-tracking tool ever be added, this policy will be updated beforehand to reflect it.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.textBefore: Your data is kept for as long as your account exists. On-request account deletion is not yet automated in the app: in the meantime, you can request the deletion of your account and your data

rights.title: Your rights
rights.textBefore: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, port, and object with regard to your data. You can exercise these rights
rights.textAfter: , and lodge a complaint with the CNIL if you believe your rights are not being respected.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: This policy may evolve along with the service, in particular if new tools (audience measurement, crowdfunding...) are added. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
